_readme: Review page named actions as saved in Klai Studio (Oct 16, 2026). submitOrder = 1) review-submitOrder.js builds model.orderPayload, 2) review-buildPrintPdfs.js builds the print PDF (base64) of every ordered card and keeps it in localStorage 'colliers-print-pdfs' (last 3 orders; NOT part of the request), 3) runUtilityHook sends the order, 4) confirms or shows submitError. FileMaker reads $$BF_Model.orderPayload in 'BF - onUtility - review' (type submit); it may set orderId or submitError. Draft FM script: fm-onUtility-review-submit.md.

submitOrder.function:
model.submitting = 0
if (model.submitError) return
console.info('[Colliers order] Order confirmed: ' + (model.orderId || '(id from FileMaker)'), model.orderPayload)
BF.namedAction('goConfirmed')
